addons.uninstallWarnRequests: Deactivating Purchase Requests will preserve existing requests but they will not be accessible. The approval flow will pause.
addons.uninstallWarnAmex: Deactivating Amex Reconciliation will preserve statements and reconciliations but they will not be accessible. Auto-reconciliation will stop.

addons.dataPreservedNote: Data is not deleted when deactivating a module. It is preserved in the database and restored when the module is reactivated.
addons.dataRetentionNotice: When deactivating a module, existing data is preserved in the database. Reactivating the module makes all data available again. Data is only deleted if the company is deleted.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Channel
whatsapp.subtitle: Receive expenses and answer queries via WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.webhookHelp: Subscribe to the messages field under Webhooks in your Meta App Dashboard. Use the URL and verify token above.
whatsapp.step1Desc: Go to business.facebook.com and create a WhatsApp Business API account. You'll get a Phone Number ID and WABA ID.
whatsapp.step2Desc: In Meta Business Settings, create a System User with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management permissions. Generate a permanent access token.
whatsapp.step3Desc: In your Meta app settings, subscribe to the messages field. Configure the webhook URL and verification token shown above.
whatsapp.step4Desc: In Users → WhatsApp Phone, link each employee to their cell phone number in E.164 format (+521234567890). This lets the system identify who sends each message.
whatsapp.step5Desc: Enter a phone number with country code (e.g. +521234567890) and press Test. You should receive a confirmation message.
whatsapp.howItWorks1: Employees send a message or receipt photo to the company's WhatsApp number
whatsapp.howItWorks2: The system identifies the user by their linked phone number
whatsapp.howItWorks3: The AI agent processes the message and responds automatically
whatsapp.howItWorks4: Managers can approve expenses directly from WhatsApp
whatsapp.capExpenses: Send receipt photos to create expenses automatically
whatsapp.capReports: Query spend reports by project or category
whatsapp.phoneLinkingDesc: When an employee sends a message from an unrecognized number, the bot asks for their email to link their account automatically.

whatsapp.linkingFlow4: Account linked! System recognizes the user and their permissions
